Quantum 1.36.0 was certified on 2026-09-21. It pins **nucleus v1.30.1**, **quark v1.15.0** and **orbit v1.12.0**, with 23 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.35.0: orbit goes from v1.10.3 to v1.12.0 (minor), nucleus stays at v1.30.1 and quark stays at v1.15.0. 4 sibling modules change version.
